critical_code_review_comments: telegram_service.send_telegram_message gracefully returns False when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/CHAT_ID missing — verified procurement endpoints stay 200. Good.

Idempotency in run_procurement_notifications relies on notifications.reminder/overdue flags being set only when TG send succeeds (ok=True). In a preview without TG creds, flags stay False so a real production scheduler will keep retrying on every tick. Consider also flagging attempts (or set flag regardless of TG success) once you're confident in TG config — otherwise risk of resend after creds added. Document this trade-off.

/procurement/components/quick-create dedup is by name regex; payload's category/unit/unitPrice are dropped silently when a same-named component exists (returns existing). FE should be aware. Consider returning a 'deduplicated' flag for clarity.
list_requests sorts by dueDate asc then createdAt desc — docs with dueDate=null may appear first depending on Mongo. Consider explicit handling.
delete_request returns 404 when nothing deleted but DELETE-as-non-admin returns 403 via dependency before route logic — confirmed.
_compute_total uses round(...,2) but quantity is float; if FE sends int it still works (verified).
